question_original: La măsurarea unei tensiuni cu multimetrul, selectarea domeniului trebuie să fie:
A_original: adecvată valorii estimate și categoriei de măsurare
source_locator: Fluke multimeter safety, measurement CAT ratings
A_analysis_PRELIMINARY: A: range compatible with expected voltage and measurement category CAT avoids overload/transient hazards.
B_analysis_PRELIMINARY: B: always lowest range risks overload/overrange, especially with unknown voltage.
C_analysis_PRELIMINARY: C: disconnecting probes can be a setup safety practice but does NOT itself define required range; not exclusive correct option.
remaining_gate: Confirm exact CAT rating and tester instruction, PDF visual, source edition and device-specific use.

question_original: Atunci când se compensează energia electrica reactiva prin baterii de condensatoare, tensiunea în reţeaua electrica:
source_locator: Reactive compensation and local voltage rise, dependency on grid impedance
A_analysis_PRELIMINARY: A: voltage can fall under other load/control conditions, but capacitive kvar normally reduces inductive drop locally.
B_analysis_PRELIMINARY: B: an ideal stiff supply may barely change; 'never' unchanged is too absolute.
C_analysis_PRELIMINARY: C: capacitor kvar may raise local voltage for inductive networks, contingent on impedance and regulator settings.
remaining_gate: Find exact manufacturer source chapter and network assumptions, no unconditional rise.

question_original: Bobinele de stingere din staţiile electrice de transformare sunt echipamente pentru:
source_locator: ABB Distribution Automation Handbook §3.15.5.3 Arc Suppression Coil
A_analysis_PRELIMINARY: A: Petersen coil is not primarily correction of commercial power factor.
B_analysis_PRELIMINARY: B: is not fire-fighting/PSI equipment.
C_analysis_PRELIMINARY: C: compensates capacitive ground-fault currents from feeder-to-earth capacitances.
remaining_gate: Open ABB exact figure/passage and compare neutral grounding type.

question_original: Câmpul magnetic poate fi produs:
C_original: de magneţi permanenţi si de electromagneţi
source_locator: Magnetic fields produced by permanent magnets and energized coils
A_analysis_PRELIMINARY: A: 'only' permanent magnets excludes electromagnet magnetic fields.
B_analysis_PRELIMINARY: B: 'only' electromagnets excludes permanent magnets.
C_analysis_PRELIMINARY: C: both magnet and solenoid/coil sources produce fields; more generally currents also do.
remaining_gate: Find exact OpenStax field/solenoid chapter and source scope.

source_locator: OpenStax University Physics 8.2 Parallel Combination
A_analysis_PRELIMINARY: A: 25 μF not equal to sum of parallel capacitances.
B_analysis_PRELIMINARY: B: 100+50+100=250 μF, three parallel elements share same voltage.
C_analysis_PRELIMINARY: C: 50 μF is merely one element, not whole parallel network.

question_original: AAR se utilizează în scopul:
C_original: reducerii pierderilor de energie pe linii.
source_locator: Automatic transfer/automatic reserve restoration operational principle
A_analysis_PRELIMINARY: A: automatic supply transfer does not inherently reduce prospective short-circuit current.
B_analysis_PRELIMINARY: B: AAR transfers to alternate source and reduces interruption, improving availability.
C_analysis_PRELIMINARY: C: the primary aim is not line-loss reduction, which depends on loading/topology.
remaining_gate: Retrieve exact AAR/autoreclosing scheme and differentiate from RAR.

question_original: Alunecarea s a unui motor asincron are valori:
source_locator: Asynchronous machine slip s=(ns-n)/ns operating regimes
A_analysis_PRELIMINARY: A: for motoring above rest to below synchronous speed, 0<s<1, with endpoints limiting cases.
B_analysis_PRELIMINARY: B: negative slip applies to generating/supersynchronous regime, not ordinary motor motoring.
C_analysis_PRELIMINARY: C: slip >1 occurs in braking/plugging modes, not normal motor operation.
remaining_gate: Explicitly scope 'motor' to motoring; source and reviewer of boundary cases.

question_original: Care element nu se foloseşte la reglarea tensiunii în reţelele electrice:
source_locator: Voltage regulation by reactive power and transformer taps; resistor not standard grid voltage device
A_analysis_PRELIMINARY: A: shunt reactors vary reactive power and can influence system voltage.
B_analysis_PRELIMINARY: B: OLTC transformer taps regulate voltage directly.
C_analysis_PRELIMINARY: C: resistor changes voltage via loss, but not typical controlled grid-voltage regulation component; 'nu se foloseşte' absolute overstatement.
remaining_gate: Locate utility grid control manual for exact equipment and distinguish resistor load banks.

question_original: Bobinele pentru limitarea curenţilor de scurtcircuit au:
source_locator: Series reactor X_L=2πfL increases short-circuit impedance
A_analysis_PRELIMINARY: A: large resistance causes heat losses and is not preferred characteristic for fault-limiting inductors.
B_analysis_PRELIMINARY: B: large inductance gives large reactance at system frequency, lowering prospective Isc.
C_analysis_PRELIMINARY: C: small inductance provides insufficient fault-current limiting reactance.
remaining_gate: Match type/rating, no assumption reactor has zero resistance.

question_original: Câmpul electrostatic este descris
source_locator: Electric field intensity E; electric displacement D=epsilon E
A_analysis_PRELIMINARY: A: field intensity vector E characterizes electrostatic field.
B_analysis_PRELIMINARY: B: 'only D' ignores E and constitutive relation, too restrictive.
C_analysis_PRELIMINARY: C: B magnetic induction is different vector field, not descriptor of pure electrostatic field.
remaining_gate: Check exact source chapter and context of vacuum/dielectrics.

question_original: Comparativ cu cele uscate, transformatoarele imersate prezintă :
B_original: risc crescut de poluare acustică a mediului ambiant;
C_original: necesitatea unor amenajări speciale la instalare
source_locator: Oil-filled transformers need containment/fire/environmental controls
A_analysis_PRELIMINARY: A: oil liquid is combustible in conventional mineral-oil design, not inherently superior fire resistance.
B_analysis_PRELIMINARY: B: oil vs dry audible noise depends design/cooling, cannot assert universal increased noise.
C_analysis_PRELIMINARY: C: oil liquid containment/spill/fire arrangement can require extra special installation provisions.
remaining_gate: Distinguish mineral vs ester liquids and exact building code; source currently too generic.

question_original: Cantitatea de căldura produsã la trecerea curentului electric printr-un conductor este:
B_original: direct proporţionala cu pătratul intensităţii curentului
source_locator: OpenStax University Physics 9.5 Electrical Energy and Power
A_analysis_PRELIMINARY: A: at fixed current/length, R=ρL/S falls with S, so heat is not directly proportional to S.
B_analysis_PRELIMINARY: B: Q=I² R t, proportional to square of current when R,t fixed.
C_analysis_PRELIMINARY: C: Q is proportional to R for fixed current, not inverse; at fixed voltage alternate scaling differs.
remaining_gate: Explicitly state fixed I,R,t assumptions and SI units.

question_original: Cantitatea de electricitate cu care se încarcă o baterie de n condensatoare montate în serie, fiecare de capacitate C, este:
A_original: aceeaşi cu care se încarcă fiecare element component
B_original: suma cantităţilor cu care se înarcă fiecare element în parte
C_original: egală cu de două ori cantitatea de electricitate cu care se încarcă fiecare condensator
source_locator: OpenStax University Physics 8.2 capacitor series charge equality
A_analysis_PRELIMINARY: A: ideal series capacitors all carry equal magnitude of charge Q.
B_analysis_PRELIMINARY: B: summed charges nQ is not the charge transferred through equivalent series branch.
C_analysis_PRELIMINARY: C: twice element charge fails unless arbitrary special case; not general.
remaining_gate: Handle initial trapped charges and parasitics explicitly.

question_original: Capacitatea echivalentă a 2 condensatoare, fiecare având capacitatea C, montate în serie este egală cu:
source_locator: OpenStax University Physics 8.2 series equivalent
A_analysis_PRELIMINARY: A: 2C is two parallel equal capacitors, not series.
B_analysis_PRELIMINARY: B: 1/Ceq=1/C+1/C=2/C, therefore Ceq=C/2.
C_analysis_PRELIMINARY: C: one capacitor value is not equivalent of two ideal series capacitors.
remaining_gate: Recompute independently, preserve unit.

question_original: Care dintre materialele electrotehnice admit o densitate de curent mai mare:
C_original: ambele admit aceeaşi densitate de curent
source_locator: Resistivity copper vs aluminum, ampacity dependent on installation
A_analysis_PRELIMINARY: A: aluminum higher resistivity typically lower ampacity at same cross-section/conditions.
B_analysis_PRELIMINARY: B: copper lower resistivity permits greater current density under comparable heat rise/installation constraints.
C_analysis_PRELIMINARY: C: same density is not generally valid for identical conductor section/temperature limits.
remaining_gate: Question lacks size, insulation and installation method, source specific ampacity required.

question_original: Care dintre relaţiile următoare este adevărată:
A_original: inducţia electrică = permitivitatea x intensitatea câmpului electric
B_original: inducţia electrică = intensitatea câmpului electric/ permitivitate
C_original: inducţia electrică=sarcina x intensitatea câmpului electric
source_locator: Electric displacement D=εE in linear isotropic medium
A_analysis_PRELIMINARY: A: in a linear isotropic dielectric D=εE, contingent on medium and constitutive model.
B_analysis_PRELIMINARY: B: dividing E by permittivity has wrong dimensions for D.
C_analysis_PRELIMINARY: C: Q×E is force-related quantity not electric displacement.
remaining_gate: Clarify medium assumptions (anisotropy, nonlinearity, polarization).

source_locator: ABB handbook multifunction bus coupler vs investment tradeoff §3.14
A_analysis_PRELIMINARY: A: shortening maneuvers may be benefit but depends switchgear sequence.

question_original: Celulele prefabricate monobloc se caracterizează în principal prin:
B_original: gamă largă de configuraţii ale schemei de conexiuni;
C_original: eliminarea totală a posibilităţii de producere a unui scurtcircuit între faze
source_locator: Prefab enclosed switchgear personnel safety and interlocks
A_analysis_PRELIMINARY: A: enclosure/interlocks can improve personnel protection compared to open assemblies.
B_analysis_PRELIMINARY: B: monobloc often less configurable than modular open-bay solutions.

question_original: Comparativ cu cele imersate, transformatoarele uscate prezintă :
B_original: risc redus de poluare acustică a mediului ambiant;
C_original: necesitatea unor amenajări speciale la instalare
source_locator: Dry vs liquid transformer fire properties
A_analysis_PRELIMINARY: A: dry-type absent mineral oil mitigates liquid fire risk; resin materials still have fire classifications.
B_analysis_PRELIMINARY: B: audible noise depends design and loading; not universal dry advantage.
C_analysis_PRELIMINARY: C: both kinds need site-specific arrangements; oil-containing variants require specific spill/fire measures.
